theorems.name: Submission.mcm_annulus_primitive_fubini
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (w : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (F F' : ℝ → ℝ) (σ ρ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → IntegrableOn w (closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ) μ → IntegrableOn F' (Ioc σ ρ) → (∀ t ∈ Icc σ ρ, F t = F σ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ t, F' τ) → IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ w x * (F ‖x - ξ‖ - F σ)) (closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ) μ ∧ IntegrableOn (fun t ↦ F' t * ∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ t, w x ∂μ) (Ioc σ ρ) ∧ ∫ t in Ioc σ ρ, F' t * ∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ t, w x ∂μ = ∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ, w x * (F ‖x - ξ‖ - F σ) ∂μ
